budget.download_note: Unique successful message payloads; historical failed/repeated transfers were not metered.

log_based_estimate.algorithm: unique payload + cycles*6*100000 assumed idx bytes + logged failed attempts*max cycle + logged starts*4 in-flight cycles*max cycle + WARN lines*30 messages*max message
assumptions: 100KB per idx; 4 cycles in flight; every warning charges 30 full messages
Historical unlogged retries, repeated idx requests and protocol overhead remain unknown; NOT a true upper bound

limitations: Development NetCDF hashes computed here: manifest supplies sizes but no registered NetCDF hashes.
Unique successful download payload excludes unmetered historical failed/repeated traffic.
Sealed content was hashed only; no GRIB decode or numerical interpretation.
